verdict.rationale: Unit's docs claim it issues physical and virtual cards with configurable controls, real-time authorization and lifecycle management. Cards are offered for business, individual and joint account customers, and accounts and cards run on a unified infrastructure, ledger and API. Digital wallet support is not mentioned anywhere, and the evidence is high-level marketing copy rather than API reference. missing for 10: digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning evidence, explicit debit-card-to-deposit-account linkage in API docs, detailed spend-control documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
